Welcome to Meadow Elves, a collection of 5,000 hand-drawn elves on BNB Chain.

Minting opens to the public on Friday at 15:00 UTC through our website.
Each wallet may mint up to five elves during the public phase. The
documentation explains rarity traits, royalties, and the roadmap for the
season.

Join the community Discord to meet other collectors and see sneak peeks
of the artwork. The contract address will be published on this page after
deployment, and the source code will be verified on the block explorer so
anyone can read it before minting.

Thank you for collecting with us.
